A stainless steel refrigerator is visible at the far left. A matte black gooseneck kitchen faucet over an undermount sink anchors the back wall. A floor-to-ceiling sliding glass door at the right edge is dressed with sheer white linen curtains, letting in diffused daylight and revealing green tree foliage outside. The floor is large-format cream limestone tile. A large terracotta planter with a tropical leafy plant sits in the foreground right. The mood is calm, bright, and warmly minimal.
